clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2, transient storage cleared at the end of the transaction and rolled back on revert (Lock.sol:12-26, NonzeroDeltaCount.sol, CurrencyDelta.sol:28-41, CurrencyReserves.sol:28-31).
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:10-25, src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:27-41 and src/PoolManager.sol:104-114 and 368-378. applyDelta computes next with checked int256 addition (CurrencyDelta.sol:36) and _accountDelta returns early for a zero delta (PoolManager.sol:369), decrements when next is zero and increments only when previous is zero, so the count equals the number of nonzero delta slots and a zero count at PoolManager.sol:112 means every delta is zero. The lock slot is only written with true or false (Lock.sol:13, 19) and unlock refuses reentry (PoolManager.sol:105). The remaining dependency is rollback of transient storage on revert, which the work file tests by simulation; mined evidence on several networks is still open as the research file's own low lead says.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2, msg.value seen once per call frame (PoolManager.sol:300-307, 354).
clearedSpotChecks.note: grep of src/ finds DELEGATECALL only in src/test (ProxyPoolManager.sol:197, MockContract.sol), not in PoolManager or its libraries. CALLVALUE is read only at PoolManager.sol:354 and 356; _settle credits msg.value once and reverts with NonzeroNativeValue when a synced ERC-20 is settled with value (PoolManager.sol:356). settle and settleFor are separate external frames, so one msg.value cannot be credited twice.

clearedSpotChecks.check: HyperEVM 0x809 as currency: the precompile ignores its input and returns the L1 block number (0x49885a18 in the earlier run, 0x49887a1e this session).
clearedSpotChecks.note: Queried https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm this session: eth_call to 0x...0809 with balanceOf(PoolManager) calldata returned 0x4988af34 and then 0x4988af3b, and with empty calldata 0x4988af3f, so the precompile ignores its input and returns a growing L1 block number. Inside one transaction a growth between sync and settle would credit a delta only in currency 0x809 (PoolManager.sol:350-364). take of 0x809 fails because the returned word is not 1 (Currency.sol:64-74). A pool pairing 0x809 with a real token would hold that token only from LPs who chose that unusual pool, so no funds of ordinary users in other pools are reachable; I did not test whether the word can change within one transaction.
